question: Can I carry out this development without planning permission?
example_seed: For a house extension, Schedule 2 Part 1 Class 1 of the Planning and Development Regulations 2001 provides an exempted-development class subject to conditions and limitations; the current 2025 consolidated Schedule should be used and every applicable condition must be tested.
guardrails: An exemption exists only if the development satisfies the applicable class and every relevant condition/limitation.
Do not answer from floor area alone.
Check previous extensions and the cumulative floor-area rules where relevant.
Check restrictions arising from planning conditions, protected structures, architectural conservation areas and other statutory constraints.
Check the current law and effective date before applying an exemption.
If the facts are insufficient, return NOT_DETERMINABLE rather than assuming permission or exemption.
